initial.light:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity static design-review IMAGE, portrait 1024x1536 (or same 2:3 aspect), extremely crisp native Chinese system typography, phone-readable at 390px width. Create ONE flat interface design image, edge to edge, NO device mockup, NO photo, no perspective, no surrounding presentation cards. This is Quiet Room's EXISTING message design adapted for voice, NOT a WeChat reproduction.

Composition: a restrained 390 CSS-pixel-wide mobile chat excerpt scaled uniformly up to fill image. Small 14px heading at top left reading exactly "语音气泡 · 静态原型 V2" and top right small theme name. Below, a single continuous chat wallpaper and normal timeline. Consistent left/right chat rails 20 CSS px from image edge. At top two standard text messages, incoming left "我发一段语音给你。" then outgoing right "好，我听一下。". Below these, four voice message rows, generously enough separated to read yet compact and realistic. Row1 incoming idle 6″ with outlined play triangle at left then 8px gap then duration; row2 outgoing playing 18″ with duration adjacent to pause icon on right; row3 incoming paused 18″ with same outlined play triangle, subtle partial ring showing retained position; row4 outgoing preparing 32″ with duration next to thin circular loading arc at right. Four rows only. Each bubble width proportional within 104–200 CSS px, body height exactly 40 CSS px, no full waveform and no scrubber. A small neutral timeline gap separates rows. Metadata BELOW each bubble, 11px "10:24", right-aligned outgoing metadata includes tiny existing double-check mark; no claim of listened-to. There is NO text naming any playback state. In all voice bubbles the ONLY visible text is 6″, 18″, 18″, 32″. Idle/play/pause/loading are conveyed through consistent 22px icons only. Use 1.8px strokes. These icons belong to same existing media design language.

CRITICAL geometry: voice bubble uses EXACTLY the same 16 CSS px rounded corners as the text bubbles with a 6px bottom corner on the speaking side (bottom-left for incoming, bottom-right for outgoing). No protruding triangular/diamond tails, no tiny R7 corners. No circular or independent colored button background around play controls. Compact original Quiet Room bubble silhouette. Do not copy WeChat voice UI. Typography is SF / PingFang SC, 16px text and 14px duration, semibold time numerals but not oversized. No avatars, no new header, no composer, no synthetic phone status bar because this is a scoped message design crop.

Footer outside chat wallpaper is a small quiet caption reading exactly "图标表达状态，气泡只保留时长". All typography legible, no cropped text or contents.

Avoid: bright saturated WeChat green, WeChat logo, bulky voice bubble, waveform, seek slider, redundant state labels (已暂停/暂停播放/正在解密/正在解压/播放中/加载中), explanatory text inside messages, decorative shadows, cards within cards, glass, arbitrary branding or irrelevant features.
Theme name text: "浅色". EXACT palette: surrounding page #f2f5f1; chat wallpaper uses existing muted yellow-green/grass-green blend (#cad381, #89be87, #66ab84, #d0d7b2) softly blended with tiny very low-contrast organic chat-line doodles. Incoming text AND incoming voice surfaces #ffffff; outgoing text AND outgoing voice surfaces identical #e0ffc6. Main text and voice icons #18231c, metadata #536159, accents #34784a. Voice and text must look like the same family of bubbles. Soft minimal one-pixel shadow like existing messages. No purple in this light version.

revision.prompt:
Edit this existing static mockup only for the user's precise correction. Preserve theme, all colors, text messages, typography, wallpaper, metadata design, light/dark identity and general message positions. This is NOT a new design.

The voice-message interaction vocabulary MUST look like familiar WECHAT VOICE MESSAGES: only a sideways radiating SOUND-WAVE glyph plus adjacent seconds, compact duration-dependent bubble widths. Replace EVERY play triangle, pause bars, circular button outline, circular progress ring and loading spinner with the SAME sideways sound-wave glyph. No triangles or play/pause/player buttons anywhere. No waveforms, seek lines or progress controls. Incoming icon is at the far LEFT and looks like three increasingly tall thin curved strokes radiating RIGHT toward the inside, like ))) with a small left dot/stroke; seconds directly to its right with 8 CSS px gap. Outgoing icon is at the far RIGHT, mirrored to radiate LEFT toward inside, like ((( with the small dot/stroke at the right; seconds directly to its left. Use current text color and simple consistent 2px rounded strokes, icon bounding box22x24 CSS px. For the four voice rows, preserve text 6″,18″,18″,32″ respectively. Row1 has ordinary static waves, row2 is a still frame of a playing wave animation (one arc faint), row3 has ordinary static waves for paused, row4 has same sound-wave glyph at 50% opacity for preparing. No spinner and NO TEXT naming any state.

Keep our own EXISTING TEXT-BUBBLE SHAPE AND COLORS, integrated with this WeChat-style VOICE CONTENT. Every voice bubble uses16 CSS px corners with6px speaking-side bottom corner, same as text messages, with NO protruding diamond or triangle tail. Voice body height40 CSS px, approximately105 physical pixels in this1024 image, so shrink voice bodies compared with source. Widths precisely follow duration:6″≈96 CSS px (252 image px); both18″≈124 CSS px (326 image px, EXACT SAME WIDTH for both directions);32″≈156 CSS px (410 image px). This compact varying-length geometry matters. Keep metadata just below resized bubble, at same left/right alignment. Do not add any new functional elements.

Change only top title to "语音气泡 · 静态原型 V2.1". Replace bottom caption with exactly "微信式语音结构，沿用现有消息气泡". No other extra text. All Chinese clear and readable. Preserve 1024x1536 output and existing theme. This revision combines WeChat's recognizable voice structure with OUR OWN existing rounded message surfaces; it must not turn into a miniature audio player.
